{ 1:<b>Description:</b>

Wraith is the most common form of Nightbound, a twisted, undead creature marked by pulsing red veins glowing beneath its scorched, decaying skin. It is the baseline form of Nightbound, a creature of pure, relentless aggression with no complex tactics or special abilities. Despite its simplicity, Wraith is no less dangerous, its mindless hunger and raw ferocity make it a constant threat.

Wraiths are easily identified by their blade-like bone growth on their right arm, a natural weapon used to slash, stab, and dismember any survivor unlucky enough to cross its path.

Unlike its more advanced or mutated kin, the Wraith has no unique abilities beyond its primal strength and aggression. It relies entirely on overwhelming its targets through sheer numbers and persistence.

{ 1:<b>Description:</b>

Pyreblast is a Nightbound creature marked by its eerie, glowing green veins that pulse beneath its decaying, soot-stained flesh. A constant stream of thick, dark smoke seeps from its body, leaving a faint, acrid haze in its wake. Despite this ominous appearance, Pyreblast behaves like a standard Nightbound, stalking and attacking survivors with mindless aggression.

The true danger of Pyreblast is only revealed upon its death. When slain, it violently ruptures, releasing a searing, toxic puddle of green acid beneath it. This caustic pool is lethally corrosive, capable of melting through armor, flesh, and even solid ground within moments. Survivors who fail to avoid the puddle risk agonizing chemical burns, while the area remains hazardous until the acid finally evaporates.
 | 2:<b>Behavior:</b>

<u>Standard Aggression:</u> Behaves like a typical Nightbound, relentlessly pursuing and attacking survivors.

<u>Constant Smoke Emission:</u> Continuously releases a thin, dark smoke, making it easy to spot.

<u>Lethal Death Reaction:</u> Upon death, Pyreblast releases a massive, deadly puddle of glowing green acid.

<u>Corrosive Hazard:</u> The acid lingers, dealing severe damage to anything caught in it.
 | 3:<b>Weaknesses:</b>

<u>Keep Distance:</u> Avoid melee combat, as its death reaction is extremely dangerous.

<u>Range Tactics:</u> Using ranged weapons minimizes the risk of stepping into the acid.

<u>Smoke Suppression:</u> Deploying smoke can neutralize the acid, causing it to evaporate rapidly.

<u>Environmental Awareness:</u> Use high ground or narrow corridors to limit acid spread.

{ 1:<b>Description:</b>

Echo is a Nightbound creature distinguished by its twisted, disfigured mouth and burning, flame-like eyes that glow a searing orange. Beneath its rotting, charred flesh, radiant orange veins pulse and flicker, casting a faint, ember-like glow even in total darkness. Echo is a relentless predator, but its true terror lies in its voice, a weapon as deadly as any claw or fang.

Once it gets close, Echo unleashes a piercing, ear-bursting screech that distorts the air itself. The sound is a violent, agonizing barrage of noise that not only deafens but physically harms anyone caught in its range. Victims feel their skin prickle, their vision blur, and their bones rattle painfully. Even sturdy armor is useless against the raw force of the soundwaves. The screech does not stop until either Echo is killed or the creature exhausts itself. Survivors often describe the experience as being flayed by sound itself.
 | 2:<b>Behavior:</b>

<u>Predatory Stalker:</u> Echo prefers to close the distance quickly, knowing its true strength lies in close-range.

<u>Lethal Screech:</u> Upon getting close enough, it releases a sustained, ear-splitting screech that damages all within range.

<u>Visual Distortion:</u> The sonic barrage not only deafens but distorts vision, making it hard to aim or move accurately.

<u>Staggering Approach:</u> While Echo is focused on screaming, it moves slower, making it slightly easier to target.
 | 3:<b>Weaknesses:</b>

<u>Distance is Key:</u> Keeping Echo at range prevents it from activating its scream.

<u>Rapid Precision:</u> Focusing fire while it’s screaming is critical to silencing it quickly.
 | 4:<b>Survivor's Note:</b>

"It’s like a razor to your eardrums. We didn’t see it until the air itself warped around us. Couldn’t hear the squad yelling... just felt my bones grinding and my skin burning. Then... silence. Only because it was dead."
